summary: A fresh, editorial recipe and weekly meal-planning app that turns what's in your fridge into a planned week, a cook-along kitchen guide and a shopping list sorted by aisle.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.spec: Three photo-led slides with large serif headlines: 'Cook what you crave' (Discover), 'Plan your week in minutes' (meal plan grid), 'Shop by aisle, waste less' (shopping list). The last slide asks for diet and household size with chips, then a 'Start cooking' button opens discover.

screens.name: Discover
screens.spec: Large serif greeting 'Good evening, Maya' with a search field below, then a horizontal row of 'What's in your fridge' ingredient chips (salmon, spinach, eggs, chickpeas, feta, lemon) that filter suggestions. The hero is a full-bleed featured recipe photo card (Miso Butter Salmon) with title, time and calories overlaid, opening recipe. Below sit two horizontally scrolling photo-card collections, 'Dinner in 20 Minutes' and 'Healthy & Bright', each card opening recipe.

screens.name: Meal Plan
screens.spec: Header 'This week · Sep 28 – Oct 4' with week arrows and a summary strip (18 of 21 meals planned, avg 1,840 kcal/day). A horizontal day selector Mon–Sun highlights today, Thursday Oct 1, followed by a vertical list of all seven days, each with breakfast, lunch and dinner slots shown as rounded recipe thumbnails with name and time; empty slots show a dashed '+ Add' tile. Tapping a filled slot opens recipe; the primary button 'Build shopping list' opens list.

screens.name: Shopping List
screens.spec: Title 'Shopping list' with a progress figure '9 of 24 items' and a thin progress bar as the hero, plus a note 'For 7 recipes this week'. Items are grouped into aisle sections (Produce, Fish & Meat, Dairy & Eggs, Pantry, Bakery) each with a coloured header, and every row has a checkbox, the item name, its quantity and the recipe it's for; checked items strike through and sink. Primary action is an 'Add item' field at the top; recipe names link to recipe.

screens.name: Saved Recipes
screens.spec: Serif title with a count '24 saved' and filter chips (All, Dinner, Breakfast, Under 30 min, Vegetarian). A two-column grid of tall photo cards shows each saved recipe with its name, time and a filled bookmark; tapping opens recipe. A small 'Cooked 3×' badge marks favourites cooked before.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: Avatar, name and a stats row (42 recipes cooked, 6-week planning streak, 24 saved) at top. A 'Dietary preferences' section shows toggle chips for diet (Pescatarian selected), allergies (Tree nuts) and dislikes (cilantro), followed by household size (2), daily calorie goal (1,900 kcal) and a list of settings rows (units, notifications for meal reminders, connected grocery store). Primary action 'Save preferences'.

screens.name: Recipe
screens.spec: Big edge-to-edge photo of Miso Butter Salmon with bookmark and back buttons, then serif title, author byline and a row of four stats: time, difficulty, calories, rating. A servings stepper (default 2) rescales the ingredient list below, shown as checkbox rows with quantities and an 'Add to shopping list' link to list, followed by numbered steps in readable paragraphs. Sticky bottom bar holds the primary 'Start cooking' button opening cooking-mode and a secondary 'Add to plan' that opens plan.

screens.name: Cooking Mode
screens.spec: Full-screen, distraction-free view with a slim progress bar (Step 3 of 6) and a close button at top. The hero is the current step in very large serif text with the needed ingredients as small chips beneath. A big circular countdown timer (08:00) with start/pause sits below the text; Previous and Next buttons span the bottom, with the final step turning Next into 'Done — enjoy!'.
